episodes.synopsis: Academically-challenged Tsukune suddenly finds himself enrolled at a mysterious high school with a shocking secret! His life may never be the same after an encounter with the mesmerizing Moka!
episodes.title: New Life and Vampire

episodes.synopsis: Moka’s obvious affection for Tsukune earns him the wrath of the school’s male students. As if that weren’t bad enough, a popular succubus is determined to seduce the poor boy!
episodes.title: Succubus and a Vampire

episodes.synopsis: A mischievous young witch stirs up trouble between Moka and Tsukune, but will a ghastly confrontation with a trio of lizardmen change her outlook on love?
episodes.title: Witchling and a Vampire

episodes.synopsis: The boys who make up Moka’s fan club decide it’s time to get rid of Tsukune, who is mortified that his puny stature makes him unable to protect his special lady friends!
episodes.title: Farewell and a Vampire

episodes.synopsis: Tsukune’s interest in the school swimming club is a big problem for Moka. It seems water has a strange effect on vampires, and a quick dip in the pool could sap her powers!
episodes.title: School Swimsuits and a Vampire

episodes.synopsis: There’s a rumor going around that Tsukune is the creep sneaking glances at other girls. Kurumu and Yukari get to the heart of the matter to clear his name.
episodes.title: Newspaper Club and a Vampire

episodes.synopsis: Tsukune attracts yet another fangirl in Mizore. How can a girl express her feelings with troublesome teachers threatening expulsion? It’s up to Tsukune to quell the beast in Moka, or things could get messy!
episodes.title: Snow Girl and a Vampire

episodes.synopsis: Private lessons from Tsukune’s seductive math teacher start subtracting from his personality. At odds with the situation, Moka’s got to snap him out of it before the hungry mentor really sinks her teeth in.
episodes.title: Math and a Vampire

episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation calls the Newspaper Club to a beach in the human world. Yukari is tempted to ditch school and join Ruby, a witch living in a coveted sunflower field nearby. Trouble brews as Tsukune attempts to break the spell.
episodes.title: Summer Break and a Vampire

episodes.synopsis: Ruby explains the plight of the sunflower fields to Yukari’s rescuers, who prove to be a curiously kind bunch. All seems to be kosher after the confusion the night before, until a forbidden spell is unleashed.
episodes.title: Sunflowers and a Vampire

episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation is over and the Newspaper Club is trying to get back to work. Unfortunately, they find their efforts complicated by the meddlesome Public Safety Commission.
episodes.title: New Term and a Vampire

episodes.synopsis: The Newspaper Club’s attempt to expose the corruption of the Public Safety Commission backfires in a big way when Tsukune is arrested and accused of being human!
episodes.title: Security Committee and a Vampire

episodes.synopsis: Tsukune’s life is on the line! Moka makes an amazing attempt to save him, and finds an unlikely ally in her mission to prevent his execution.
episodes.title: Tsukune and a Vampire
